sources: https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/20250004148/downloads/viper-2025-04-24.pdf (20 cm/s max driving speed; 0.8 cm/s Speed Made Good; 15 deg slope design limit)
https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/20230004239 (up to 20 cm/s on flat terrain; effective speed ~1 cm/s after commanding, localization, navigation and obstacle-avoidance delays)
speed_assumptions.caveat: VIPER is a teleoperated robotic rover, used here as an analog. Replace if the mission rover is a different vehicle.

direct.description: Shortest path that avoids slopes above the limit

balanced.description: Trades some length for gentler slopes

flattest.description: Strongly prefers flat ground, even if longer

notes: Routes are least-cost paths on a 5 m/px slope raster, not verified safe paths.
Boulders, small craters, soil softness and shadow are NOT modeled.
Drive time excludes stops (diagnosis, comms, sampling, setup).
